name: Alex Okonkwo
summary: Backend-leaning software engineer with 9+ years building and operating production systems in Go, Python, and TypeScript, from payments ledgers to healthcare data pipelines. Comfortable owning services end to end — design, on-call, and everything between — and shipping across the stack when a small team needs it.

bullets.text: Designed and shipped a Go-based ledger service handling double-entry postings for 40,000+ daily merchant transactions, cutting settlement reconciliation errors by 92% versus the legacy spreadsheet process.
Rebuilt the payment authorization path around idempotent Kafka consumers, eliminating duplicate-charge incidents that had previously caused roughly 15 support escalations per month.
Migrated authorization and settlement services from a monolith to independently deployable Go microservices on Kubernetes (EKS), reducing p95 authorization latency from 640ms to 180ms.
Introduced structured logging and OpenTelemetry tracing across 12 services, cutting mean incident diagnosis time from about 45 minutes to under 10.
Led a 6-person on-call rotation and authored the team's incident postmortem process, driving a measurable drop in repeat incidents quarter over quarter.
Built a Django/FastAPI hybrid backend ingesting HL7 and claims data from 30+ partner clinics, normalizing records into a canonical PostgreSQL schema used by downstream reporting.
Designed Celery-based async pipelines for nightly claims batch processing, cutting processing time for a 2-million-row nightly job from 6 hours to 50 minutes.
Implemented row-level access control and audit logging to meet HIPAA-adjacent data handling requirements ahead of a customer security review.
Wrote and safely rolled out 40+ zero-downtime PostgreSQL migrations against tables exceeding 200 million rows using online schema-change tooling.
Partnered with the clinical operations team to redesign the claims-intake API, cutting partner integration time from several weeks to under 3 days.
Built the core React/TypeScript invoicing and reconciliation UI for an early-stage SMB accounting product, taken from prototype to the first 500 paying customers.
Designed and implemented a Node.js/Express REST API and PostgreSQL schema powering the product's core ledger, invoicing, and customer records.
Integrated Stripe for subscription billing and payment reconciliation, handling webhook-driven state sync between Stripe and internal records.
Worked directly with the two founders and early customers to scope and ship features end to end on a weekly release cadence.
Designed and implemented core Solidity smart contracts for a lending and collateral protocol, including collateralized borrowing, liquidation logic, and interest accrual.
Wrote a Foundry test suite with fuzz and invariant tests covering liquidation edge cases, reaching over 95% branch coverage on the core contracts.
Optimized contract storage layout and reduced gas cost of the core deposit function by 34% ahead of a third-party audit.
Prepared audit documentation and resolved all high- and medium-severity findings from an external security review before mainnet deployment.
Created and maintain pgtrail, an open-source Go CLI for auditable, reversible PostgreSQL schema migrations, with over 1,400 GitHub stars.
Designed the plugin architecture that let external contributors add MySQL and SQLite support without touching the core migration engine.
Reviewed and merged 150+ community pull requests and triaged incoming issues, growing the active contributor base from 2 to 20.
Graduated with First Class Honours in Computer Science, with coursework concentrated in distributed systems and databases.
Final-year project: built a distributed key-value store implementing the Raft consensus algorithm in Go.
Served as a teaching assistant for the Data Structures and Algorithms course for two semesters.
